admin_contact_policy.description: The site admin queue is strictly for bug reports, broken critical infrastructure, and severe help desk issues. Users must review this FAQ before submitting a task.

faq.question: How do I use the Chrome Extension?
faq.answer: Make sure you are logged into the workspace. Open all the tabs you want to extract, and hit the 'Ctrl+Shift+X' hotkey. The extension will grab all URLs, screenshots, and closed captions and invisibly pipe them to your active workspace.

faq.question: The AI gave me a shortlink for an auth wall. What do I do?
faq.answer: Copy the shortlink and paste it into a browser tab where you are already logged into the target site (like Facebook or a private portal). The system will automatically absorb the session and complete the extraction.

faq.question: Why is my extraction stuck in Suggestive Work?
faq.answer: Suggestive Work tasks are executed by the autonomous AI during off-hours or when the primary pipeline has idle capacity. You do not need to manually trigger them.

faq.question: Is the AnythingLLM connection secure?
faq.answer: Yes. Our proxy routing guarantees that dangerous connections (like deep web or hostile infrastructure) are processed physically away from your local machine to protect your IP and liability.
